_about: Written by the morning update. 'ticker' = the next 3 Texas events (shown under the logo unless the owner turns on 'Use my own ticker' in the editor). 'stories' go in columns (left, center, right), plus at most one daily banner story (slot 'banner', with 'dropTo' = the column the owner's banner drops into while it shows); the owner controls feature and top links and can hide or edit the automatic banner. Hidden story ids live in the site's hiddenAuto list. 'expired' = [{url, reason}] of column stories (owner's or auto) about games that are over; the front page hides those in left/center/right unless the owner listed the URL in keepUrls. Never banner/feature/top.

stories.headline: Season over for Kobe Black as Horns head into A&M week
Volleyball's SEC run ends: No. 11 Tennessee storms back from 0-2 down, tops Horns 15-12 in the fifth
Aggies' game notes: Texas leads the series 78-37-5 — A&M hasn't beaten the Horns in College Station since 2007
The villain returns: two years after a 17-7 win before 109,028 at Kyle Field, Horns head back with plenty at stake
Sark: DT Hero Kanu 'potentially' back for the playoffs; Horns played 74 guys vs. Arkansas, most all season
End of an era on 26th Street: Madam Mam's closes its West Campus Thai spot Dec. 18 after 25 years near UT
Georgetown arrives 6-0: Ed Cooley's Hoyas get their shot at No. 7 Texas Thursday in San Diego
Campus housing shakeup: Creekside off the renewal list, Dobie Twenty21 closes for 2027-28 as 1,000-bed Whitis hall rises
Horns on the Aggies: 'good players everywhere' — LB Lance Jackson says underdogs play with more fire
Women hold at No. 6 in AP poll after Ohio State win; South Carolina unanimous No. 1
Elko still won't name an A&M QB — Sark: Horns expect to see both Reed and Hart
Golden: A&M is 'a dead team walking' — but that guarantees nothing for the Horns
PG Isaiah Johnson could miss the San Diego trip; Horns face Georgetown Thanksgiving, then Louisville Dec. 1
[Flip]: Denton CB John Catlin IV, brother of ex-Horn Ja'Tavion Sanders, jumps from Arkansas to Texas — 24th 2027 commit
Sark tells Horns to tune out the Arch, draft and playoff noise — ESPN: a win at Kyle Field all but locks up a CFP bid
Commit: 2028 Sierra Canyon OT Lance Ciechanowski picks Horns over UCLA, Ole Miss
New AP poll: unbeaten Horns (6-0) slip a spot to No. 7 as Houston leaps to No. 1
Not pretty: Booker opens 0-for-5, Schaefer frets over rebounding as women 'stumble' past Ohio State
West Campus zoning fight back on: council member Zo Qadri eyes UNO update in early 2027
Sark after the rout: only 29 first-half plays, 10-1 in November since joining the SEC, short week to Kyle Field
ESPN FPI: Horns 83.9% favorites at Kyle Field
Aggie beat writer: Elko 'ran out of options' as A&M managed 189 yards in Norman
Report card: Horns get an A for the Arkansas rout while Ohio State and Indiana take D's
Snap judgments: Arch 21-of-25, McDonald's pick-six, and now 4-7 A&M on Black Friday
